collect.heading: Information we collect
collect.body: When you use this website, we may collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and any other details submitted through our contact or booking forms. We may also collect certain technical information automatically, such as your browser type, pages visited, and approximate location. [To confirm — full data inventory pending]

use.heading: How we use your information
use.body: Information you provide is used to respond to your enquiries, process appointment requests, and communicate with you about services. We do not use your information for marketing, and we never send marketing emails.

retention.body: We retain your information for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. [To confirm]

access.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you. To make a request, please contact us. [To confirm — add formal process]

security.body: We take reasonable steps to protect the information we hold. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. [To confirm]

contact.heading: Privacy contact
contact.body: For privacy-related enquiries, please contact us at meenaerie@gmail.com. Alternatively, use the contact form on this website.

disclaimer.title: Important information about this website
disclaimer.notice: This disclaimer is a placeholder pending formal legal review. All content is subject to change. Last updated [Date].
disclaimer.crisis: If you are in crisis: Contact emergency services on 000, Lifeline on 13 11 14, or go to your nearest emergency department. This website is not a crisis service.

general.heading: General information
general.body: This website provides general information about art therapy services offered by Daw Mi and her creative practice, Art of Wellness. It is intended for informational purposes only.

notAdvice.heading: Not personalised advice
notAdvice.body: Nothing on this website constitutes personalised therapeutic, medical, psychological, or clinical advice. Information presented here is general in nature.

relationship.heading: Browsing does not create a therapeutic relationship
relationship.body: Reading this website, submitting a contact or booking form, or communicating with Daw Mi through this website does not create a therapeutic relationship. A therapeutic relationship is only established through a formal agreement.

scope.heading: Scope of professional services
scope.body: Daw Mi provides art therapy and creative wellbeing services within the scope of her qualifications and professional registration. She is a member of the Australian Community Counselling Association (ACCA), her professional body.

noGuarantee.heading: No guaranteed outcomes
noGuarantee.body: Art therapy and creative wellbeing sessions may not be suitable for everyone. Outcomes vary between individuals and cannot be guaranteed.

emergency.heading: Emergency and crisis situations
emergency.body: This website is not a crisis service. If you are experiencing a mental health emergency, please contact emergency services (000 in Australia), Lifeline (13 11 14), or your nearest emergency department.

externalLinks.heading: External links
externalLinks.body: This website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about the information on this website, please use the contact form.

requests.heading: Appointment requests and confirmation
requests.body: Submitting a booking request does not confirm your appointment. You will receive a separate confirmation from Daw Mi once your request has been reviewed, usually within 2 business days.

rescheduling.heading: Rescheduling
rescheduling.body: If you need to reschedule, please contact Daw Mi as early as possible. [To confirm — process and notice requirements]

cancellation.heading: Cancellation
cancellation.body: Cancellations must be made with sufficient notice. Please refer to the notice periods below.

noticePeriods.heading: Notice periods
noticePeriods.body: Please give at least 48 hours’ notice if you need to cancel or reschedule a session.
